observers.presentation: Only the separately labelled public Tcl_GetStringFromObj phase requests counted bytes. A later explicit caller-header getter is not evidence that a previously selected worker reached that getter.

process_protocol.producer_receipt: Fsync original stdout/stderr and the actual process receipt immediately after process completion, before after-process input/header/link/runtime verification.

process_protocol.output_reuse: Fresh614b provider output directory only; compile independently from the unchanged probe and selected original SDK inputs.
